notes.title: 1.5: Some small QoL Tweaks
notes.content:
Hello!
A small updated today featuring a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2276980/discussions/0/594031952382769510/]few recent requests[/url].

- Window reset button! This can be accessed through the taskbar menu. It will instantly reset all window placements to the default positions. Useful if a window has gone out of view. Nice to finally have this in.
- Number truncation. In endless mode, super big numbers will now get shortened (ie $10500000000 now will show as $10.5b). Easier to read, and prevents some UI glitches that were happening.
- A new option to lock the hovered-over states in the hardware monitor, so you can always see the surplus/deficit values. The toggle can be found in Billing Breakdown.
- Small updates to the Brazilian Portuguese translation, including achievement localization, with thanks to Acanixz!

That's all for now, but there are some exciting updates in the pipeline which I look forward to sharing. 

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: 1.41: Mini patch for cameras, and the Polish game price
notes.content:
Hello! Just a small update today. Inspired by the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2276980/discussions/0/595157217621114530/]following bug report[/url], I've now updated FaceFinder Cameras to unlock infinitely. Before, they had a hard cap that I incorrectly assumed people wouldn't reach. I should have known better! This should make Endless games a little bit more Endless (watch this space for more on that).

I also pushed up a small manual decrease to the game price in Polish Zloty, as the auto-suggested price for Zloty had fallen out of line relative to the rest of the world due to currency fluctuations. Pleased to have fixed this one.

Speak soon!

notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to 1.2.1! We have a few bugfixes and a micro feature.

MICRO FEATURE:
- In Endless Mode, add an option to automatically sell harvested data every 10 seconds via the Surveillance Hub. Maybe that saves you some clicks. Thanks to 47GodlikeKittinSoldier for posting the idea on the discussion board!

BUGS:
- Made it impossible to open more than one instance of FACEMINER (as in the actual Steam Game, not the in-game-meta-software), which will [i]hopefully[/i] help to resolve any remaining Windows 11 alt+tab issues.
- More work towards ensuring Endless Mode remains stable during longer sessions for all users. Do let me know if you are still running into issues after this update.
- Made clock position more robust across different resolutions.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Pre-1.2.0 Patch
notes.content:
Hello! Today, we have a little pre-release of the 1.2.0 update. 1.2.0 will be all about localization, but before it’s time for that, we squash a couple of bugs.

Bugfixes:

- Fix issue where the game would forget whether special effects were disabled on launch. Or, to be more specific, figured out why the game would crash on launch if it started with special effects disabled so we could enable the remembering.

- Get closer to fixing issue where uncloseable phantom windows appear for some Windows 11 users after alt-tabbing the game (or changing the window size). This is pretty much the final boss of launch bugfixes but it should now be happening for less of you.

- Very quietly add first batch of translations. Soft launch for these while the full list goes through final checks; more languages and a larger announcement coming soon.

Thank you for playing.

notes.title: 1.1.3: You can hack and modify your saves now
notes.content:
[i]Warning: very minor end game state spoilers ahead
[/i]

Hello!

1.1.3 is now live, and has a fun new feature: the [b]Memory Override[/b] executable. This appears on the end game desktop (you know the one) after finishing the game, and lets you dive into and modify all of the saves you made in that specific run. The whole game state is up for grabs. This includes stuff like:

- Money
- Upgrades
- All of the in-game messages
- All of my secret dev settings

You can then export and share these modified saves as you wish. Kind of like a baby game modder.

The catch? These modified saves won’t count towards achievements, and will be marked as ‘modified’ elsewhere in the game, too. But it opens the door to some potentially fun and interesting ways of breaking the game.

Other, smaller changes:

- Can now, at last, delete datasets you have bought or harvested to clear your backlog
- Code has been migrated to use an i18n library, paving the way for translations. Has been rigorously checked but do let me know if you spot any syntax errors as this will be why. If you are a translator who has played the game and would be interest in localizing it (or providing localization QA) in your favorite language, get in touch with your rates!

notes.title: Minor Update (1.1.2)
notes.content:
A small bucket of patches.

— Advanced 'double click purchase' technology now works for everything, not just datasets.
— Made the 'cannot buy' messages for software in the marketplace a little bit clearer (ie, tells you in advance if you don't have enough storage or memory, before you try and click buy).
— Fixes for the 'close call' and 'big spender' achievements.
— Improvements to impact prediction reliability.
— Potential fixes for some Linux edge cases.
— Fix bug/soft infinite loop that would happen if there was more than one fatal error happening at a time. Surprised this one didn't cause more problems! Maybe you're all too good.

And, before I forget, I should mention the game now has a Speedrun page! Just in case anybody has the urge to get something on there. That #1 spot is very much up for grabs.

Thank you for playing ːsteamthisː

notes.title: Achievements Unlocked!
notes.content:
FACEMINER is now 1.1.0! What’s new?

[h2]Achievements
[/h2]

By popular demand, FACEMINER now has 56 achievements to unlock. Many challenges, secrets, and absurdities await those who seek them out.

[h2]Playable on Steam Deck 
[/h2]

FACEMINER is now officially playable on Steam Deck! More work to do here (mostly on the font size front) to get the Steam Deck experience at parity with the desktop one, but this is a robust first step towards getting that green fully verified tick.

[h2]More bugfixes
[/h2]

1.1.0 makes significant strides in terms of session stability, particularly for durational (endless) games. The bug some users were facing where some sessions would use artificially low in-game resources, only to show the full usage again on reload, is now squashed for good. Behind the scenes, we’ve made changes to some in-game calculations which will generally make things easier to expand, rebalance and update in future.

---

Thank you everyone: it continues to be a pleasure to work on this.

notes.title: 1.035 Minor Miner Update
notes.content:
Welcome to [u][b]1.035[/b][/u]. Not gonna lie: this one isn't very exciting. But 1.035 walks so that 1.036 can run.

[b]BUGFIXES:
[/b]
— Fix bug where the Save Game upgrade was sometimes locked in endless mode games
— Fix bug where the menu page would not honor audio/volume settings
— Fix bug where rolling income would get stuck if income becomes zero
— Fix bug where previous fullscreen state was not remembered
— Small calculation stability improvements

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

— Improvements to performance of visualizer & cluster computing 3D views
— Decrease level required to get the secret top rank
— Balancing tweak for endless mode that makes emissions charges less extreme (and prone to billion dollar spikes) in late-late-game. More to come here.
— Add scaffolding for achievements

notes.title: v1.034 - Cloud Saves + Endless Mode Stability Patch
notes.content:
Hello!
1.034 is now live. Pretty tight focus for this one:

[u][b]Steam Cloud Saves.[/b][/u]
These are now live! To be [i]extra[/i] safe, a backup of all of your saves is made locally in a non-synced folder each time the game is ran, so if you plan on using this feature I recommend (after updating) playing the game on the machine with the saves you care about on first to secure that local fallback.

[u][b]Improving late game stability on Endless Mode.[/b][/u]
I have had a few reports from players who are seeing random spikes in their electricity use while playing (in-game, thankfully not IRL), especially on either lower spec computers or on very fast AutoMode upgrade levels. I have introduced a new setting in the advanced section of the settings menu called [i]‘stability mode’[/i]. The tldr is that this will make calculations more stable/predictable by fixing them to the AutoMode level rather than calculating the speed dynamically, which was always a bit of a rogue approach. It is disabled by default in normal runs and existing (legacy) endless mode games, but can be toggled on at any time. Otherwise, it is now the default for all new ‘endless mode’ games.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: v1.033: Post-release Patch-fest MKII
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you again for being here; I remain humbled and a little astonished by your presence. We’re now just over a week from the launch, and it’s feeling like the perfect time for Round 2 of the post-launch patches.

— LOG —

- Hopefully fixed the bug where ghost windows would haunt the machines of some users after closing the game. Not good, this one.
- Made it impossible to delete unused cluster computing connection code messages.
- Added a popup message to alert the user when Infinite Money Glitch mode is unlocked after completing the game on the Slow mode. I think a few were missing this — it’s pretty fun!
- Fix temperature unit bug where some temperatures would still show in F when C was selected.
- Added more safety checks to calculations, and began migrating to big.js for the less frequent .operations. General aim being to prevent numbers from slipping and corrupting save data.
- Few typo fixes.
- Added a toggle to disable the automatic pause (that happens when the game window is inactive) to the settings menu.
- Fixed bug where save and firewall upgrades would be locked in endless mode.
- Fix bug where downgrading the first camera level to 0 would re-lock the surveillance hub.
- Added scrollbar to dataset list.
- Paved the way to cloud saves; just a few more checks to do here and these can go live.

That’s it for now! Few more bugs to squash, and it’ll soon be time to move onto something a little more exciting.

notes.title: v1.032: Post-release Patch-fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all: thank you for checking out FACEMINER! It seems like people are generally enjoying their experience with it, which is really nice to see.

This is a mini patch which addresses the most common bugs which have been reported so far. Full list below:

- Fix for a few different bugs that were happening with the audio, including the voice message ducking causing strange side effects and settings not being applied between sessions.
- Fixed bug where reactors were appearing twice in some endless mode sessions, causing lots of downstream impacts if the shadow-glitch-reactor was purchased (eg an [i]unintentional[/i] infinite money glitch*)
- Fix for the 'final rank' not triggering in endless mode. Embarrassing!
- Fix where opening the logstream at the end of the game would cause some sessions to crash
- Add error catching to the manager graph hovering, as a safety precaution 
- kWh -> kW, MWh -> MW, etc.

*An [i]Intentional[/i] infinite money glitch can be unlocked by beating the game on the slower difficulty, btw.

My apologies to anyone who was inconvenienced by these, and thank you for being an early FACEMINER adopter. Onwards!

notes.title: FACEMINER Demo Version 1.00 Released!
notes.content:
Version 1.0 of the FACEMINER demo is now released! The 'beta' disclaimer has been left in the dust and we have our first full version number to prove it. There has been no better time to try out the demo.

With this update comes some pretty big changes -- primarily around the [b]BALANCE[/b] of the self-contained demo experience. 

To those who played the demo before and were left defeated by its unforgiving nature, we urge you to try again. The days of runs that go on for hours is over; you will lose faster, the game will (auto)save more often, and if you do win, it'll happen in around half the time.  The result amounts to what is hopefully a nimbler experience for all. It may even approach being 'enjoyable' in places for some users (unconfirmed).

[b]What else is new?
[/b]

- A massively overhauled message-reading voice! This was the most requested improvement by far. Thanks again to Madwreck with the help on nailing these.

- Removed emissions from the demo and simplified the surveillance feature a little — these will both come into their own more in the full game, but for now we're nerfing them

- VFX can now be disabled through the menu

- Many small tweaks to the visuals and narrative/emails; little polishes to make your mining experience better.

- Many small bugfixes, too numerous and tedious to mention Thank you for reading, and Happy Mining.
